context: M31 o1. Sunday, the Arden's back table. Claudette with her arms folded. Twenty women.

lines.speaker: char.claudette_bijou
lines.text: Delphine. I trust your head. Today I want to count the shoebox.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Count it. Every dollar is there. I put back what was missing. My own.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: It's eleven hundred short. Tina's cousin. My mistake. I'll make it good.

lines.speaker: char.tina_mercado
lines.text: My mistake, not Del's. I'll pay it back. Every week. You can count it.

lines.speaker: char.rita_haines
lines.text: Sit down, sugar. Nobody makes a good decision standing up. Vote.
